merits.name: Common Sense
merits.summary: Once per chapter, roll Wits + Composure to ask the Storyteller a guidance question.

merits.name: Danger Sense
merits.summary: +2 on reflexive rolls to notice an ambush before it springs.

merits.name: Direction Sense
merits.summary: Always knows facing and location; no penalties to navigation.

merits.name: Eidetic Memory
merits.summary: No rolls to remember experiences; +2 to recall fine details.

merits.name: Encyclopedic Knowledge
merits.summary: Roll Intelligence + Wits to know a useful fact about the chosen Skill's field.

merits.name: Eye for the Strange
merits.summary: Can tell whether a scene's cause is natural or supernatural.

merits.name: Fast Reflexes
merits.summary: Quick to react: adds to Initiative.

merits.name: Good Time Management
merits.summary: Halves the time between rolls on extended actions.

merits.name: Holistic Awareness
merits.summary: Treats injuries and illness using natural remedies instead of medical gear.

merits.name: Investigative Aide

prerequisites.text: The chosen Skill at 3 or more

merits.summary: With the chosen Skill, uncovering Clues gets exceptional success at three successes.

merits.name: Investigative Prodigy
merits.summary: Uncovers several Clues in one instant action.

merits.name: Meditative Mind
merits.summary: Improved meditation; higher levels add composure bonuses and easier success.

merits.name: Multilingual
merits.summary: Conversational in two chosen languages; can roll to read them.

merits.name: Patient
merits.summary: Two extra rolls allowed on extended actions.

merits.name: Professional Training

styleManeuvers.name: Networking
styleManeuvers.summary: Gain two dots of Contacts tied to the profession.

styleManeuvers.name: Continuing Education
styleManeuvers.summary: Asset Skill rolls get 9-again.

styleManeuvers.name: Breadth of Knowledge
styleManeuvers.summary: Pick a third Asset Skill and gain two Specialties among Asset Skills.

styleManeuvers.name: On the Job Training
styleManeuvers.summary: Gain one dot in an Asset Skill; take a Beat whenever buying an Asset Skill dot.

styleManeuvers.name: The Routine
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower to make an Asset Skill roll a rote action.

merits.summary: Career training that boosts a Profession's Asset Skills.

merits.name: Tolerance for Biology
merits.summary: No rolls needed to withstand gore and biological horrors.

merits.name: Vice-Ridden
merits.summary: Has two Vices, still limited to one Willpower per scene from them.

merits.name: Virtuous
merits.summary: Has two Virtues; choose which to use when refreshing Willpower.

merits.name: Ambidextrous
merits.summary: No off-hand penalty.

merits.name: Automotive Genius
merits.summary: Vehicles can carry more modifications: triple Crafts instead of double.

merits.name: Crack Driver
merits.summary: Adds Composure to Drive rolls; three dots allows a reflexive Drive action.

merits.name: Demolisher
merits.summary: Ignores one point of object Durability per dot.

merits.name: Giant
merits.summary: Very large: Size 6 and one extra Health.

merits.name: Hardy
merits.summary: Adds dots to resist disease, poison, deprivation, unconsciousness, suffocation.

merits.name: Greyhound
merits.summary: In chases, exceptional success needs only three successes.

merits.name: Iron Stamina
merits.summary: Cancels fatigue and wound penalties, one point per dot.

merits.name: Quick Draw

prerequisites.text: A Specialty in the chosen weapon or fighting style

merits.summary: Drawing or holstering the chosen weapon is reflexive.

merits.name: Relentless
merits.summary: Chase opponents need two extra successes to catch or escape.

merits.name: Seizing the Edge
merits.summary: Always holds the Edge in a chase's first turn.

merits.name: Small-Framed
merits.summary: Small: Size 4, one less Health, bonus to hide.

merits.name: Stunt Driver

styleManeuvers.name: Defensive Driving
styleManeuvers.summary: Attacks on the moving vehicle are penalized by Drive dots.

styleManeuvers.name: Speed Demon
styleManeuvers.summary: Each acceleration success adds 10 Speed instead of 5.

styleManeuvers.name: Drift
styleManeuvers.summary: No maneuvering roll needed to turn at high speed.

styleManeuvers.name: Clipping
styleManeuvers.summary: When ramming deliberately, ignore own-vehicle damage equal to Wits, before Durability.

merits.summary: Driving Style with defensive and high-speed techniques.

merits.name: Closed Book
merits.summary: Hard to read or manipulate; adds Doors and contested dice.

merits.name: Fixer
merits.summary: Lowers the Availability of hired services by one.

merits.name: Pusher
merits.summary: Accepted soft leverage also counts as satisfying the mark's Vice.

merits.name: Small Unit Tactics
merits.summary: Extends a planned group action's Willpower bonus to several allies.

merits.name: Spin Doctor
merits.summary: Tainted Clues cost a -1 penalty instead of lost successes.

merits.name: Table Turner
merits.summary: Spend Willpower to preempt Social Maneuvering against you.

merits.name: Takes One to Know One
merits.summary: Investigating crimes matching one's Vice gives a bonus, not a penalty.

merits.name: Untouchable
merits.summary: Investigations into the character get Incomplete Clues unless exceptional.

merits.name: Aura Reading
merits.summary: Spend Willpower and roll to read a subject's aura for emotions and nature.

merits.name: Automatic Writing
merits.summary: Trance in which a spirit writes cryptic clues.

merits.name: Biokinesis
merits.summary: Shift Physical Attribute dots temporarily; heals faster.

merits.name: Clairvoyance
merits.summary: Projects senses to a distant place via a chosen scrying method.

merits.name: Cursed
merits.summary: Knows the manner of his doom; fearless as a result.

merits.name: Laying on Hands
merits.summary: Heals others by touch but takes on part of the harm.

merits.name: Medium
merits.summary: Hears and speaks with the dead; can strengthen ghostly Conditions.

merits.name: Mind of a Madman
merits.summary: Thinking like a culprit grants 8-again to hunt them, at a mental cost.

merits.name: Omen Sensitivity
merits.summary: Once per session, read omens to ask yes-or-no questions.

merits.name: Numbing Touch
merits.summary: Psychic touch numbs targets and can drain Willpower.

merits.name: Psychokinesis
merits.summary: Control one elemental force; five dots can create it from nothing.

merits.name: Psychometry
merits.summary: Reads emotional impressions and events from objects and places.

merits.name: Telekinesis
merits.summary: Moves objects with the mind; dots act as Strength.

merits.name: Telepathy
merits.summary: Reads surface thoughts; five dots can send messages.

merits.name: Thief of Fate
merits.summary: Touch steals luck, causing dramatic failures; boosts own Willpower dice.

merits.name: Armed Defense

styleManeuvers.name: Cover the Angles
styleManeuvers.summary: When Dodging, multiple-attacker Defense penalty starts one attacker later.

styleManeuvers.name: Weak Spot
styleManeuvers.summary: Disarm an armed attacker if your Defense cuts their pool or successes to zero.

styleManeuvers.name: Aggressive Defense
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower: excess Dodge successes inflict lethal damage on the attacker.

styleManeuvers.name: Iron Guard
styleManeuvers.summary: Trade weapon bonus for Defense each turn; when Dodging, add full weapon bonus after doubling.

styleManeuvers.name: Press the Advantage
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower: after a block that zeroes an attack, make an unarmed counter at -2.

merits.summary: Weapon-based defensive Style.

merits.name: Cheap Shot
merits.summary: Dirty trick that can strip an opponent's Defense next turn.

merits.name: Choke Hold
merits.summary: Grapple move that can render a victim unconscious.

merits.name: Close Quarters Combat

styleManeuvers.name: Firing Lines
styleManeuvers.summary: Give up action to reach cover within twice Speed in reaction to gunfire.

styleManeuvers.name: Hard Surfaces
styleManeuvers.summary: Grapple Damage move against a hard surface deals lethal, then ends the grapple.

styleManeuvers.name: Armored Coffin
styleManeuvers.summary: Add opponent's general armor to grapple pool; Damage moves ignore armor.

styleManeuvers.name: Prep Work
styleManeuvers.summary: Dexterity + Stealth for a surprise attack becomes rote (Brawl/Weaponry only).

styleManeuvers.name: Turnabout
styleManeuvers.summary: Disarm results step up one level; can seize the weapon.

merits.summary: Style using the environment and grapples to hurt people.

merits.name: Defensive Combat
merits.summary: Use Brawl or Weaponry in place of Athletics for Defense.

merits.name: Fighting Finesse

prerequisites.text: A Specialty in Weaponry or Brawl

merits.summary: Use Dexterity in place of Strength with one weapon Specialty.

merits.name: Firefight

styleManeuvers.name: Shoot First
styleManeuvers.summary: With gun drawn, add Firearms to Initiative.

styleManeuvers.name: Suppressive Fire
styleManeuvers.summary: Covering Fire denies enemies aiming bonus; keep Defense against gunfire; works with semi-autos.

styleManeuvers.name: Secondary Target
styleManeuvers.summary: Hit a covered target with debris: bashing damage, ignore cover penalties, no weapon bonus.

merits.summary: Practical gunfighting Style.

merits.name: Grappling

styleManeuvers.name: Sprawl
styleManeuvers.summary: Grappled opponents cannot Drop Prone or Take Cover.

styleManeuvers.name: Takedown
styleManeuvers.summary: Knock an opponent prone instead of grappling, optionally dealing bashing equal to successes.

styleManeuvers.name: Joint Lock
styleManeuvers.summary: Joint Lock grapple move deals bashing next turn; overpowering moves add 1 lethal.

merits.summary: Wrestling Style.

merits.name: Heavy Weapons

styleManeuvers.name: Sure Strike
styleManeuvers.summary: Drop three attack dice to add 1 to weapon damage this turn.

styleManeuvers.name: Threat Range
styleManeuvers.summary: If not moving or Dodging, enemies closing in take 1 lethal and a Defense penalty.

styleManeuvers.name: Bring the Pain
styleManeuvers.summary: Sacrifice Defense; damage dealt becomes the victim's penalty next turn.

styleManeuvers.name: Warding Stance
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower to add weapon damage as armor for a turn (not vs firearms).

styleManeuvers.name: Rending
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower before attacking to add 1 aggravated damage on a hit.

merits.summary: Style for big two-handed weapons.

merits.name: Improvised Weaponry

styleManeuvers.name: Always Armed
styleManeuvers.summary: Reflexive Wits + Weaponry to grab a usable weapon; no improvised-weapon penalty.

styleManeuvers.name: In Harm's Way
styleManeuvers.summary: Use the found weapon's Structure as armor against one melee attack.

styleManeuvers.name: Breaking Point
styleManeuvers.summary: On an all-out attack, sacrifice weapon Structure for extra damage.

merits.summary: Style for turning found objects into weapons.

merits.name: Iron Skin
merits.summary: Toughened body: armor against bashing; can downgrade lethal.

merits.name: Light Weapons

styleManeuvers.name: Rapidity
styleManeuvers.summary: Drop weapon damage to zero for the turn to add Weaponry to Initiative.

styleManeuvers.name: Thrust
styleManeuvers.summary: Trade Defense points one-for-one into attack dice.

styleManeuvers.name: Feint
styleManeuvers.summary: A no-damage feint lets the next attack bypass Defense and add damage.

styleManeuvers.name: Flurry
styleManeuvers.summary: While Defense is available, adjacent enemies take 1 lethal each turn.

styleManeuvers.name: Vital Shot
styleManeuvers.summary: Sacrifice Defense; a hit adds 1 aggravated damage.

merits.summary: Finesse Style for small one-handed weapons (damage 2 or less).

merits.name: Marksmanship

styleManeuvers.name: Through the Crosshairs
styleManeuvers.summary: Max aiming bonus becomes Composure + Firearms instead of 3.

styleManeuvers.name: Precision Shot
styleManeuvers.summary: Lower weapon damage one-for-one to cancel specified-target penalties.

styleManeuvers.name: A Shot Rings Out
styleManeuvers.summary: Fire into a crowd at a target without penalty; never hit the wrong person.

styleManeuvers.name: Ghost
styleManeuvers.summary: Firearms penalizes rolls to find the shooter's position.

merits.summary: Aimed-shooting Style; no Defense on turns it is used.

merits.name: Martial Arts

styleManeuvers.name: Focused Attack
styleManeuvers.summary: Specified-target penalties reduced by 1; ignore 1 armor.

styleManeuvers.name: Defensive Strike
styleManeuvers.summary: Add 1-2 to Defense, losing an attack die per point; not with Dodge.

styleManeuvers.name: Whirlwind Strike
styleManeuvers.summary: While Defense is up, adjacent enemies take 1 bashing per turn (2 with Willpower).

styleManeuvers.name: The Hand As Weapon
styleManeuvers.summary: Unarmed strikes deal lethal damage.

styleManeuvers.name: The Touch of Death
styleManeuvers.summary: Unarmed strikes may count as 2-damage weapons.

merits.summary: Formal unarmed fighting Style.

merits.name: Police Tactics

styleManeuvers.name: Compliance Hold
styleManeuvers.summary: +2 on overpowering rolls to disarm or immobilize.

styleManeuvers.name: Weapon Retention
styleManeuvers.summary: Disarming you needs more successes than your Weaponry.

styleManeuvers.name: Speed Cuff
styleManeuvers.summary: Restrain an immobilized foe reflexively.

merits.summary: Restraint and arrest Style.

merits.name: Shiv
merits.summary: Hides small weapons usable with Brawl.

merits.name: Street Fighting

styleManeuvers.name: Duck and Weave
styleManeuvers.summary: Take -1 on actions to use the higher of Wits or Dexterity for Defense.

styleManeuvers.name: Knocking the Wind Out
styleManeuvers.summary: A successful unarmed hit gives -1 to the target's next roll.

styleManeuvers.name: Kick 'Em While They're Down
styleManeuvers.summary: Inflict Knocked Down when successes beat Stamina; hit foes standing up.

styleManeuvers.name: One-Two Punch
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower on a hit for 2 extra bashing.

styleManeuvers.name: Last-Ditch Effort
styleManeuvers.summary: While wounded, spend Willpower and Defense to counterattack first.

merits.summary: Gritty unarmed Style learned in real fights.

merits.name: Unarmed Defense

styleManeuvers.name: Like a Book
styleManeuvers.summary: Against unarmed foes, when not Dodging, add half Brawl (round down) to Defense.

styleManeuvers.name: Studied Style
styleManeuvers.summary: One chosen foe's attacks don't lower your Defense.

styleManeuvers.name: Redirect
styleManeuvers.summary: When Dodging, a zeroed attack is turned onto another attacker.

styleManeuvers.name: Joint Strike
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower: roll Strength + Brawl instead of Defense to injure and Wrack a limb.

styleManeuvers.name: Like the Breeze
styleManeuvers.summary: When a Dodge zeroes an attack, knock the attacker down.

merits.summary: Defensive unarmed Style that redirects blows.
